description: Publish a draft or scheduled post immediately to all connected platforms. X (Twitter): nothing sent to X may contain a link (URL, bare domain or t.co) — not the post, any thread segment, or a first comment (posted to X as a reply). The X API bills each link post at $0.20 vs $0.015, so the API rejects them; put a link-free version in platformContent.twitter.
name: publish_post
